# Pinned browser dependencies

- `jszip-3.10.1.min.js` — copied unchanged from `Stuk/jszip` tag `v3.10.1`, file `dist/jszip.min.js`, upstream Git blob `ff4cfd5e8fdc49176c2d1d409afa897f40be01f4`. License in `jszip-LICENSE.markdown`.
- PDF.js is loaded on demand as an ECMAScript module at a fixed, patched version. Its worker must be the matching version.

Review dependency upgrades and run learning-workspace Playwright tests before changing these versions.
